about: Every string the spelling map changed while building the Brennan's house: the research writes British English and the house is American, so each British form became its American spelling.

changes.before: Extra Brut means very little added sugar, under six grams a litre: very dry, with citrus, orchard fruit, brioche and a firm, chalky finish. The live list shows $28 a glass; the restaurant’s own drinks page shows $30 — check the current price.
changes.after: Extra Brut means very little added sugar, under six grams a liter: very dry, with citrus, orchard fruit, brioche and a firm, chalky finish. The live list shows $28 a glass; the restaurant’s own drinks page shows $30 — check the current price.

changes.before: Our house Champagne is a Piper-Heidsieck Extra Brut bottled under the Brennan's name, so it is drier than a standard Brut; a blend of all three Champagne grapes from the Piper-Heidsieck house. Piper-Heidsieck spells its own cuvee Essentiel. Say 'labelled for us', not 'made for us', until a bottle is checked, and do not quote a dosage or a lees age until the sommelier confirms which cuvee is in the bottle. The Bubbles page lists a bottle at $125, $75 during Bubbles.

changes.before: Light-bodied Mosel Riesling from old vines: green apple, peach, slate and racy acidity. It is off-dry: a touch of sweetness, about twenty grams of sugar a litre, with only 11.5% alcohol and racy Mosel acidity, which is why it is our glass for spice and for the maple on the duck. The estate is at Ürzig in the Middle Mosel, a family with roots to 1510. Taste it at lineup if the vintage has changed.

changes.before: Five courses. Wine pairing supplement $120, five 4 oz pours: Charles Lafitte Brut, Fichet Mâcon-Igé 2024, Louis Jadot Beaune 1er Cru 2023, Paul Hobbs Coombsville Cabernet 2021, La Tour Vieille Banyuls Reserva. Open the Jadot 20 to 30 minutes ahead, the Hobbs 30 to 60; pour the Banyuls before the Snickers lands. Three of the five pours are variables between the guide and the house page: the lobster pour (Fichet Mâcon-Igé 2024 or Domaine Matrot Meursault 2023), the redfish pour (Jadot Beaune 1er Cru 2023 or Jadot Beaune Bressandes 1er Cru 2022) and the dessert pour (La Tour Vieille Banyuls Reserva or M. Chapoutier Banyuls); the Lafitte and the Paul Hobbs are the pours both sources share. The duck course is printed two ways. Read the printed card on shift. The pairing costs more than the food; do not apologise for it.

changes.before: Our wine director is Sam Bortugno, an Advanced Sommelier, in post since September 2023; confirm at lineup that he is on the floor tonight and how to call a sommelier to a table. changes.before: Brennan's has captains; staff train for months before cooking Bananas Foster tableside, and a new server does not flame a pan before sign off.
